sessions.phase_label: Pre-award concept sketch and design brief
Detailed unit layout, entrance, kitchen, and bathroom revisions
Final layout review and construction handoff

requirements.title: Three-Unit Dwelling Program
requirements.definition: Divide the existing residence into three self-contained dwellings, with unit 1 configured as 2+1 and the other units retaining their separately defined room programs.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers dwelling count and room-count programs only; entrances, partitions, kitchens, and bathrooms remain independently evolving Requirements.

requirements.title: Existing Wall Retention
requirements.definition: Minimize alterations by retaining and reusing existing interior walls wherever the new dwelling layout permits.
requirements.boundary_note: This is the general wall-retention constraint; the exact walls to demolish or construct are owned by the separate partition-layout Requirement.

requirements.title: Interior Partition Wall Layout
requirements.definition: Define the interior walls to remove and construct so the three dwelling layouts and their rooms are properly separated.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns specific demolition and construction lines; corridor width and allocation are separately testable aspects of the common-corridor Requirement.

requirements.title: Common Corridor and Entrance-Hall Layout
requirements.definition: Configure the shared corridor and entrance-hall boundaries, width, allocation, and usable residual space without creating impractical door conflicts.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers shared-space geometry and allocation, including proposed transfer of entrance-hall area to unit 1; it excludes the independent requirement for steel entrance doors.

requirements.title: Open-Plan Kitchen Cabinetry
requirements.definition: Provide each dwelling with kitchen cabinetry directly integrated into its living room rather than enclosed in a separate kitchen room, using approximately 180 cm of upper and lower cabinets per dwelling.
requirements.boundary_note: Cabinet length, open-plan form, and associated appliance depiction are attributes of the common kitchen mechanism; unit-specific counter locations remain separate.

requirements.title: Unit 3 Kitchen Counter Location
requirements.definition: Place the unit 3 kitchen counter so it fits the room while preserving usable clearance from the bathroom door.
requirements.boundary_note: Unit 3 counter placement can change independently of the common open-plan cabinet specification and of unit 1 kitchen placement.

requirements.title: Unit 1 Kitchen and Common-Bath Arrangement
requirements.definition: Determine and retain the usable relative locations of unit 1's kitchen and common bathroom, including resolution of the proposed location swap.
requirements.boundary_note: The kitchen-and-bathroom swap is one relational layout decision; bathroom size, door operation, drainage, and the en-suite remain separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Unit 1 Common-Bathroom Geometry
requirements.definition: Define the boundaries and usable dimensions of unit 1's common bathroom, including its proposed expansion to the marked boundary.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns room size and boundaries only; door swing, toilet drainage, and the separate en-suite bathroom can evolve independently.

requirements.title: Unit 1 En-Suite Bathroom
requirements.definition: Provide unit 1 with a second bathroom connected to the principal bedroom and arrange its shower, toilet, sink, washing machine, and associated doorway so the required fixtures fit.
requirements.boundary_note: Fixture fit and bedroom connection are tightly coupled parts of the en-suite mechanism; the independently debated common-bathroom door operation is excluded.

requirements.title: Unit 1 Bathroom Door Operation
requirements.definition: Configure the identified unit 1 bathroom door as a usable sliding or hinged door with a safe opening direction and adequate clearance from fixtures and the apartment entrance door.
requirements.boundary_note: Door type and swing have their own modification and collision-feasibility trajectory, independent of bathroom size and fixture selection.

requirements.title: Unit 1 Toilet Drain Alignment
requirements.definition: Position the unit 1 toilet close enough to an existing waste connection to avoid an impractical drainage arrangement.
requirements.boundary_note: Drain alignment is independently assessable from bathroom geometry; the image-dependent toilet relocation in message 95 requires later routing verification.

requirements.title: Unit 2 Bathroom Door Location
requirements.definition: Position the unit 2 bathroom door near the center of the bathroom wall as requested, subject to layout feasibility.
requirements.boundary_note: This unit-specific door location can be revised without changing the other bathroom doors or unit 2 drainage.

requirements.title: Unit 2 Toilet Drain Alignment
requirements.definition: Position the unit 2 toilet with respect to existing waste connections so its plumbing remains feasible.
requirements.boundary_note: Kept separate because drainage feasibility can fail or change for one dwelling without changing the other bathrooms.

requirements.title: Unit 3 Bathroom Geometry and Fixture Layout
requirements.definition: Provide a usable unit 3 bathroom with sufficient width and a workable arrangement of the shower, toilet, sink, washing machine, and door.
requirements.boundary_note: Width and fixture positions are parameters of one room-layout mechanism; routing the toilet waste to the existing drain is a separate plumbing Requirement.

requirements.title: Unit 3 Toilet Drain Routing
requirements.definition: Locate and route the unit 3 toilet drain toward an existing waste connection, with the extent of design-stage plumbing responsibility explicitly resolved.
requirements.boundary_note: This plumbing path has its own feasibility and scope conflict and therefore is separate from unit 3 bathroom width and fixture arrangement.

requirements.title: Existing Common Entrance Door
requirements.definition: Retain the existing common exterior steel entrance door as the shared access point for the subdivided dwellings.
requirements.boundary_note: Preservation of the building-level entrance is independent of providing a separate steel door for each dwelling.

requirements.title: Independent Steel Doors for Each Unit
requirements.definition: Provide each of the three dwellings with its own steel entrance door connected through the retained common entrance, with locations that avoid impractical conflicts.
requirements.boundary_note: Door count, material, and shared-vestibule clearance form one access mechanism; retention of the original common door is separate.

requirements.title: Exterior Window Retention
requirements.definition: Preserve the existing exterior facade windows in the revised floor plan.
requirements.boundary_note: Window retention can remain unchanged even if the balcony treatment or interior partitions change.

requirements.title: Balcony Retention
requirements.definition: Keep the existing balcony open and separate from the adjoining room unless enclosure provides a concrete design benefit.
requirements.boundary_note: Balcony enclosure is an independently decidable envelope change and is not an attribute of exterior-window retention.

requirements.title: Floor Plan Design Deliverable
requirements.definition: Produce an initial layout sketch followed by a refined digital floor plan and associated design visuals for the subdivision.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the requested plan artifacts and their refinement, not administrative milestone delivery or the substantive design requirements depicted in them.

requirements.title: Dimensioned Floor Plan
requirements.definition: Annotate the floor plan with the requested room, wall, bathroom width, fixture, door, and door-offset dimensions.
requirements.boundary_note: The various measurements are attributes of one independently requested drawing-annotation deliverable rather than separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Furniture and Appliance Layout Drawing
requirements.definition: Provide a separate plan showing representative furniture and major appliances, including sofas, televisions, beds, wardrobes, and refrigerators.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an independently requested visualization artifact; it does not own the underlying room, kitchen, or bathroom geometry.

unresolved_candidates.description: The short approval in message 33 cannot be safely mapped to all image-dependent layout proposals in messages 29 and 30 without the omitted attachment context.
The messages report that bathroom fixtures and dimensions fit, but the text alone does not unambiguously identify which unit or bathroom owns the result.
The marked-image context is needed to confirm which unit 1 bathroom is expanded to the turquoise boundary and whether it is the common bathroom or en-suite.
Message 94 appears to accept retaining the current unit 1 kitchen and bathroom arrangement, but message 96 asks for final confirmation and no explicit response is visible.
The toilet to be moved closer to a drain is identified only through a missing image marker, so it cannot yet be safely routed to a specific unit bathroom.
